name: search_places
description: Search for a location by name. Returns a list of matching places with addresses. Use this to find the pickup or dropoff location before booking a ride.

query.description: The place name or address to search for, e.g. "Lekki Phase 1" or "Murtala Muhammed Airport"

lat.description: Optional latitude to bias results toward the user's area

lng.description: Optional longitude to bias results toward the user's area

name: get_place_details
description: Get the exact coordinates and full address for a place using its place_id (returned from search_places). Call this after search_places to get lat/lng needed for fare estimates and booking.

place_id.description: The Google place_id from a search_places result

name: get_fare_estimate
description: Get available vehicle types and fare estimates for a trip. Returns a list of vehicle options with prices, ETAs, and vehicle type IDs needed for booking.

name: book_ride
description: Book a Rovv ride. Requires pickup/dropoff coordinates, a vehicle_type ID (from get_fare_estimate), and payment method. Returns booking confirmation with ride number.

is_later.description: Set to true for scheduled rides

trip_start_time.description: For scheduled rides: datetime in Y-m-d H:i:s format

name: cancel_ride
description: Cancel an active ride. Optionally provide a reason.

request_id.description: The ride request ID to cancel. If not provided, cancels the current active ride.

name: get_current_ride
description: Get the status of the user's current active ride, including driver details, ETA, and ride status.

name: get_ride_history
description: Get the user's past ride history. Returns recent completed and cancelled rides.

limit.description: Number of rides to return (default 5, max 20)

name: get_route_info
description: Get driving route information between two points including distance, duration, and polyline.

name: get_wallet_balance
description: Get the user's Rovv wallet balance, total added, total spent, and recent transactions.
